content.short: SmolRefuel lets wallets refuel by exchanging any tradable coin for gas and bridges gas tokens to 80+ chains.
content.description: Running out of gas and funds getting stuck is frustrating. SmolRefuel enables a gas-ready workflow by letting you swap any tradable coin in a wallet for gas without paying upfront, ensuring you can always refuel when needed. It also bridges gas tokens across networks, supporting instant transfers to more than 80 chains. This cross-chain capability covers Ethereum and OP Mainnet, Arbitrum, Base, Polygon, Avalanche, Fantom, Celo, Cronos, Harmony, BNB Chain, and Solana.
